name: session-hub
description: One Mod status pane for Claude Code Desktop with an icon rail: Progress (live plan bars with step times and history, forked from zycck/claude-mods plan-progress), Next steps (up to three suggested next prompts; a click puts one in the composer) and Cache (how long the prompt cache stays warm). One footer entry opens the pane; the terminal keeps the progress band and the next-steps band

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

critic.title: Model that grades the suggestions
critic.description: Ask for six candidates and let this model keep the best three, one per kind; off shows the fork's own three.

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime in minutes
ttlMinutes.description: Fix the cache lifetime instead of learning it: 60 for the 1-hour cache, 5 for the 5-minute one, 0 to learn it from the responses.

warnMinutes.title: Warn this many minutes before it expires
warnMinutes.description: The countdown turns orange in its last minutes.
